invariants.rationale: Method calls on data (stream, etc.) require data to be non-null.
Delegation to throwingMapToPairWrapper(mapToPairFunc) requires mapToPairFunc to be non-null.
reduceFunc is passed to throwingReduceWrapper and must be non-null for reduce operation.
A positive parallelism is meaningful for parallel processing and may be enforced by the context.
The size of a list is always non-negative.
